Q1: How should the documented members be classified with respect to original versus SMBB biomass-burning forcing protocol?

Evidence states: LENS2 has two 50-member halves: original biomass-burning forcing and an 11-year-running-mean version, SMBB. At each of four macro-initialization dates, first ten micro-perturbation members use original forcing and second ten use SMBB. Ten additional even-decade initializations use original; ten odd-decade use SMBB.

So there are members using original (50) and members using SMBB (50). The collection contains members using each of the two documented forcing protocols. That's "two_protocol_groups".

It's not within_run_replicates because each member doesn't contain both; they're separate members.

Q2: Does the documented difference between these halves isolate biomass-burning smoothing as the only implementation change?

Evidence: "The SMBB implementation also corrects emission-dataset issues and changes the timing of a crop-harvest carbon-flux term... Additional output fields also differ."

So the SMBB half incorporates other documented implementation changes beyond smoothing. Even if reports say no significant impact, the implementation changes exist. So the difference does NOT isolate smoothing as the only change. Answer: "bundled_changes" - No; the SMBB half also incorporates other documented implementation changes.
